dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a subtle concave spline curvature from the apex toward the posterior dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Highest morphological point is rounded with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin rises at an approximate 55-degree angle relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Melon displays a broad, continuous convex arc with a large radius forming the primary anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Proportional pixel length is short and blunt, with thickness nearly equivalent to the visible extension beyond the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense global cyan-green bioluminescent luminosity featuring a highly saturated longitudinal core-band along the lateral midline.
